name: forevye-nexus
description: FOREVYE NEXUS - sanal ekonomi mobil bankacılık benzeri uygulama (gerçek para/banka yok)

scripts.deploy: npm run db:migrate:remote && npm run db:verify:remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.sync-shared: cp shared/card-contract.js public/js/card-contract.js && cp shared/card-rules.js public/js/card-rules.js && cp shared/card-skins.js public/js/card-skins.js
scripts.test: node --test test/app.test.mjs test/market.test.mjs test/editor.test.mjs test/pass.test.mjs test/shop.test.mjs test/card-money.test.mjs test/card-render.test.mjs
scripts.db:verify:remote: wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --command "SELECT balance FROM cards LIMIT 0" && wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --command "SELECT id, tx_ref, user_id, card_id, type, amount, balance_after, counterparty_id, idempotency_key, description, created_at FROM card_ledger LIMIT 0" && wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --command "SELECT purchase_id, user_id, card_id, product_id, created_at FROM shop_card_deliveries LIMIT 0"
